associations.rationale: The displayed type only makes ExactFunctor a proposition on a functor; it does not expose preservation of exact sequences as the proposition's defining condition.
The displayed type only makes LeftExactFunctor a proposition on a functor; it does not state which end of an exact sequence is preserved.
The displayed type only makes RightExactFunctor a proposition on a functor; it does not state which end of an exact sequence is preserved.
The formal type relates exactness to the conjunction of left and right exactness, but it does not state that any of these predicates means preservation of the corresponding exact-sequence ends.
